correctness.rationale: Unordered 2-point graph configuration of the explicit 12-vertex/18-edge truncated tetrahedral graph; sufficient subdivision holds for two particles because essential vertex paths and 3-edge cycles meet Abrams/Prue–Scrimshaw hypotheses. Independently constructed the 66 zero, 180 one and 117 two cubical cells with their product orientation boundaries. The 10 geometrically disjoint facial product 2-cycles form kernel columns with Smith diagonal all units, so a primitive rank-10 lattice in C2. Independent mod-2 elimination gives rank ∂2=107, while the 10 cycles force rational rank <=107, proving complete top kernel. A 115-nontree-edge basis for ker ∂1 gives an integral 115×117 boundary whose Smith form has exactly 107 unit factors, so H=(Z,Z^8,Z^10), no torsion. Independently transported oriented triangle/hexagon face cycles by every one of 24 S4 relabelings, computed chain Lefschetz and torus pair signs; the five conjugacy-class traces are H1 (8,-4,0,2,0) and H2 (10,2,-2,1,0). Character inner products give 2sgn+2V′ in H1, 1+2V+V′ in H2; rational invariant dimensions of S4/A4 yields quotient Betti (1,0,1)/(1,2,1). No quotient homotopy or integral representation irreducibility is inferred.
